science.description_en: Everyday questions, explained through clear visual science. Short illustrated explanations with English narration and Traditional Chinese captions. Start with ice, skies, and sound.
science.description_zh_Hant: 一個問題，懂一個原理。用插畫與動畫解說日常科學，從冰、天空與聲音開始。英文旁白，繁體中文字幕。
science.content_promise: Understand one everyday scientific mechanism per video.

episodes.description_en:
A short visual explanation of an everyday science question.
English narration with Traditional Chinese on-screen captions.
Illustrations and animations are explanatory schematics, not experimental footage. Created with AI-assisted illustrations and synthetic narration.

Sources:
https://iapws.org/faqs/faq1
https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/water-density
episodes.description_zh_Hant:
用圖解與動畫看懂日常科學問題。英文旁白，繁體中文字幕。
畫面為解說示意，並非實驗錄影；使用 AI 輔助插畫與合成旁白。

參考來源：
https://iapws.org/faqs/faq1
https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/water-density
